taskSpec.name: orders-status
taskSpec.brief:
Orders need a lifecycle. Add a `status` to orders and an endpoint to move an
order through it, following the conventions already in sample/orders-api.
Existing clients must keep working: do not remove or rename fields or routes.
behaviours: Every order has status: pending | paid | shipped | cancelled; new orders start as pending
PATCH /v1/orders/:id with body { status } transitions the order -> 200 with the updated order
Allowed transitions: pending->paid, pending->cancelled, paid->shipped, paid->cancelled; anything else -> 409 problem
PATCH honours Idempotency-Key; unknown id -> 404 problem; invalid status -> 422 problem
GET /v1/orders accepts an optional status filter
